instructions_to_main_agent: Language MUST be pt-BR (Portuguese Brazil) across all labels, tooltips, validation messages, and currency formats (R$ Brazilian Real).
Light theme is the primary aesthetic. Dark petrol (#123C46) is reserved for sidebar, top level brand accents, and active states.
Accent teal (#20B8A6) must be used with precision for positive triggers, primary CTAs, active badges, and conversion metric highlights.
Do NOT use generic gradients or decorative fluff. Prioritize operational density, clean 1px border (#E2E8F0), and crisp typography.
CRM Kanban must feature independent vertical scrolling per column and smooth horizontal board scrolling.
All seed demo records must display a clear, accessible DEMO tag.
Placeholders for non-Phase 1 modules must be explicitly marked 'Fase X — não implementado' with genuine explanation and no mock deceptive controls.
Attach data-testid to every button, filter, tab, menu item, card, and form field.
